content.text: PR #228 is up as a draft (https://github.com/Banon-Labs/ds2-mods-rs/pull/228) — draft because repo policy refuses non-draft PRs, and it is not ready to merge until the one unproven step happens: you launch DS2, press F6 in game, and confirm `DS2LE.log` has no `F6 press detected` line and the GPU does not reset.
